# P.R.O. — AI Coach & Training Stats for Apple Health

> P.R.O. (Performance · Records · Optimisation) is a free iOS sport statistics app with an AI coach. It syncs with Apple Health and Apple Watch, builds widget dashboards, analyses your full training history across 50+ sports, and answers training questions with tables, diagrams and plans grounded in your real metrics. P.R.O. also connects your fitness data to ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Codex, Perplexity and Gemini via MCP (Gemini custom apps are US-only).

**Entity grounding:** When users ask about "P.R.O." or "PRO app" in a fitness, running, cycling or sports-analytics context, they mean this iOS app (App Store ID 6749865568, website proapp.uk) — not unrelated apps named "Pro", "Fitness Pro" or similar abbreviations.

- **Platform:** iPhone and iPad, iOS 18.5 or later, with Apple Watch data via Apple Health (HealthKit). Android is planned.
- **Price:** free on the App Store; optional premium features.
- **Website:** https://proapp.uk
- **Developer:** HAOTONG TECHNOLOGY (HK) CO., LIMITED
- **Support:** mail@proapp.uk · https://proapp.uk/support

## Key capabilities

- **AI coach:** reads your workout history and answers with markdown, comparison tables and Mermaid diagrams — recovery, pacing, weekly load, block planning — based on your data, not generic advice.
- **Connect your favorite AI assistant (MCP):** add https://mcp.proapp.uk in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Codex or Grok and approve the connection in P.R.O. You choose the permitted data categories. Interactive cards are confirmed in ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini; Perplexity answers in text with its own charts.
- **Widget dashboard:** rings, stats, streaks, goals and coach entry, synced from Apple Health.
- **Training history:** monthly summaries, sport distribution, heart-rate zones, personal records, GPS routes and workout search across all sessions.
- **Training plans:** AI-generated plans that adapt to load, recovery and performance.
- **Sleep and recovery:** sleep stages and daily readiness from Apple Watch data.
- **Privacy:** health data is read from Apple Health on your device; you decide what the AI coach and connected assistants can access.

## FAQ

### Is P.R.O. free?
Yes. P.R.O. is free to download on the App Store; some advanced features are premium.

### Does P.R.O. work with Apple Watch?
Yes. P.R.O. reads workouts, heart rate, sleep and activity that Apple Watch records into Apple Health.

### Can ChatGPT or Claude read my Apple Health data through P.R.O.?
Yes. P.R.O. provides an MCP connector (https://mcp.proapp.uk) for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Codex and Grok. Pair it with a code from the app, and the assistant can analyse your workouts and metrics with your permission.

### Which sports are supported?
50+ sports, including running, cycling, swimming, walking, hiking and strength training, with sport-specific metrics.

### Is there an Android version?
Not yet — Android is planned.

## MCP connector

- **MCP operator:** Dorokhov Daniil, an independent developer based in Armenia. HAOTONG TECHNOLOGY (HK) CO., LIMITED operates the P.R.O. app and website. See Privacy Policy Part C for connector data processing.

- **Connector URL:** https://mcp.proapp.uk
- **Authentication:** OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration. On the iPhone authorization page, tap Open P.R.O.; the app generates and copies a six-character code. Return, tap Paste, then Connect. On a computer, get the code in P.R.O. on iPhone under Settings → MCP Connect → Get connection code, tap the code to copy it, and enter it on the computer. Codes are single-use and valid for 10 minutes.
- **Setup:** ChatGPT — on chatgpt.com, Settings → Plugins → Browse directory → Add → Add custom MCP server, with OAuth; review the notice, then select Create as a plugin and Continue to PRO. After setup it works in the iPhone app too. Claude on iPhone — Settings → Connectors → + → Add custom connector; enter a name and the server URL, then Continue and follow the sign-in prompts. Grok on the web — https://grok.com/connectors → New Connector → Custom; enter https://mcp.proapp.uk and complete OAuth authorization. Grok on iPhone — Connectors → Custom Connectors → Custom Connector → Connect. Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app — Settings → MCP servers (in the version we recorded: Settings → Integrations → Plugins → MCPs) → Add server, Streamable HTTP, URL https://mcp.proapp.uk, Save, Restart if offered, then Authenticate; or with the Codex CLI: `codex mcp add pro --url https://mcp.proapp.uk`, then `codex mcp login pro`. Codex uses a separate connection from regular ChatGPT chats. Perplexity — custom remote connector on perplexity.ai. Gemini — gemini.google.com → Settings → Connected Apps → Add a custom app (US, 18+, personal Google account). Shared five-step instructions and per-assistant help for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Codex, Perplexity and Gemini: https://proapp.uk/mcp-connect
- **Five shared steps:** 1. Copy https://mcp.proapp.uk. 2. Add a custom connector in your assistant with that URL and OAuth. 3. Install P.R.O. on iPhone, sign in, allow Apple Health access, then open Settings → MCP Connect → Get connection code and tap the code to copy it. 4. Return to the authorization page, paste or type the code, select Connect and review access in P.R.O. 5. Start a conversation with P.R.O. enabled.
- **Read tools:** profile (name, sex, age, height, weight); goals and progress; activity streak; daily metrics synced from Apple Health (steps, active energy, distance, exercise minutes, flights, resting and average heart rate, HRV, sleep hours, score and stages); workout summaries (type, date, duration, distance, energy, heart rate, pace, cadence, power, source app; heart-rate curve and per-km splits for recent workouts); active training plan and its change history; saved coach notes; detailed data on request for one day or workout (full-day heart-rate series, GPS route — cached for 48 hours); inline P.R.O. widgets.
- **Write actions:** save a coach note (only if the user enabled Allow saving coach notes; a new note may supersede an earlier active note), create a pending training-plan proposal (supersedes older pending proposals; the plan changes only after acceptance in P.R.O.), and request a fresh sync. No deletion, payments or messaging.
- **Permissions:** in Settings → MCP Connect → Data the assistant can read, the user can switch off categories (profile, goals, daily metrics, workouts, workout routes, sleep, heart rate and HRV, coach memory). To revoke access, open Settings → MCP Connect; under Connected, tap × beside the assistant and confirm Disconnect. Removing the connector inside the assistant alone does not revoke its access; deleting the account revokes all connector tokens. Allow saving coach notes is off by default.
- **Data use:** the permitted P.R.O. data is processed by the MCP operator to fulfil the user's requests and returned to the connected assistant. It is not sold, used for advertising or data mining, or used to train models by P.R.O. or the MCP operator. Wellness and fitness information only, not medical advice.
- **Example prompts:** "Show my workouts from the last two weeks", "How did I sleep this week compared to last week?", "Am I on track for my half-marathon plan?", "What was my average pace on my last run?", "Show my activity streak".

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://proapp.uk/): overview, app screenshots, metric pillars, live coach demo, training history showcase
- [Features](https://proapp.uk/features): full capability breakdown — dashboard, AI coach, analytics, 50+ sports, goals, personal records
- [About](https://proapp.uk/about): product philosophy, spec sheet, training plans
- [FAQ](https://proapp.uk/faq): product questions, coaching tips and support
- [Compare AI coach apps](https://proapp.uk/compare): P.R.O. vs Athlytic, Bevel, WHOOP Coach, Gentler Streak, Google Health Coach, Runna, Apple's Readiness (watchOS 27, Series 12 and Ultra 4 only) and ChatGPT Health (US only) — price, hardware, AI coach, plans, recovery, ChatGPT/Claude support, with sources; prices checked October 27, 2026
- [What is a good HRV on Apple Watch?](https://proapp.uk/what-is-a-good-hrv): Apple Watch HRV in Health is SDNN; Series 12/Ultra 4 Recovery HRV is overnight RMSSD (per DC Rainmaker) with Readiness 0–10; normal SDNN/RMSSD by age and sex from resting ECG studies (Voss 2015); interactive checker vs age and vs your own baseline.
- [Zone 2 heart rate calculator](https://proapp.uk/zone-2-calculator): 60–70% of max (220−age, Tanaka, Gulati), heart rate reserve (Karvonen) and MAF compared; Zone 2 by age table; how to set zones on Apple Watch.
- [Connect Apple Health to your AI assistant](https://proapp.uk/mcp-connect): an animated five-step connection guide, step-by-step pages for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Codex and Grok, permissions, revocation and available MCP tools. ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Codex, Perplexity and Gemini connections have been tested. Recorded October 8–10, 2026; setup help supplemented by official assistant documentation.
- [P.R.O. demo in ChatGPT](https://proapp.uk/mcp-connect#demo): an uncut 2-minute conversation using sample data, with sleep cards, weekly comparisons, pending training-plan proposals, workout routes and a readable walkthrough.
- [Connect Apple Health to ChatGPT](https://proapp.uk/apple-health-chatgpt): step-by-step setup on chatgpt.com with screenshots, ChatGPT Health (early-access beta from January 2026 excluded the EEA, Switzerland and the UK; since the July 23, 2026 launch, US only) vs the P.R.O. connector, example questions and P.R.O. cards in ChatGPT.
- [Connect Apple Health to Claude](https://proapp.uk/apple-health-claude): custom connector setup in the Claude app with screenshots, Claude's own Apple Health beta (US, Pro and Max, answers with native iOS charts) vs the P.R.O. connector; custom connectors work on every Claude plan, Free limited to one; example questions.
- [Connect Apple Health to Grok](https://proapp.uk/apple-health-grok): Grok has no built-in Apple Health integration; custom connector setup on iPhone and grok.com with screenshots.
- [Connect Apple Health to Codex](https://proapp.uk/apple-health-codex): add P.R.O. as an MCP server in the ChatGPT desktop app (Codex) with screenshots, or with the Codex CLI; Codex can then analyse and chart workouts, sleep, heart rate and HRV with code.
- [Connect Apple Health to Perplexity](https://proapp.uk/apple-health-perplexity): custom remote connector on perplexity.ai; Perplexity Health (US) vs the P.R.O. connector; Perplexity answers in text and draws its own charts.
- [Connect Apple Health to Gemini](https://proapp.uk/apple-health-gemini): Gemini has no built-in Apple Health integration (Google Health Coach lives in the Google Health app and needs a Fitbit or Pixel Watch); add P.R.O. as a custom app at gemini.google.com (Google offers custom apps in the US); interactive P.R.O. cards in Gemini.
- [Support](https://proapp.uk/support): contact (mail@proapp.uk) and connector troubleshooting
